# Houses of Heaven

> Official website for Houses of Heaven, a California-based (Oakland, Sacramento, and LA) band blending techno rhythms, early industrial, shoegaze, and 90s dance music influences like drum and bass.

Houses of Heaven is Keven Tecon (vocals, keys, guitar), Adam Beck (keys, guitar), and Rachel Travers (drums). Keven was formerly a member of The Soft Moon, and both Keven and Rachel were members of the Bay Area's Wax Idols.

## Pages

- [Home](https://housesofheaven.com/): Band bio and latest news
- [Live](https://housesofheaven.com/live): Upcoming tour dates and shows
- [Music](https://housesofheaven.com/music): Streaming and purchase links for releases
- [Video](https://housesofheaven.com/video): Music videos
- [Contact](https://housesofheaven.com/contact): Mailing list signup and booking contacts
